access.title: Public access
access.description: Make services at home available remotely. Choose direct access or a public relay automatically, with ongoing port and DNS maintenance.
access.networkDescription: Check your network to suggest an access method. Saved services are maintained automatically.
access.detectionLimit: Network detection identifies a possible access method. Only an independent external check can confirm public reachability.
access.upnpMissing: Automatic router mapping is unavailable. Check that this host is on the router’s local network and enable UPnP, or configure a public relay.
access.relaySetupDescription: This network may not accept incoming connections. A relay server with a public address lets your home host connect outward instead.
access.staleState: Connection interrupted. Showing the last received state.
access.emptyDescription: Start with your home host’s IP and service port. Keep automatic selection to let PandaHome choose the access method.
access.maintenanceNote: Status updates every {seconds}s; maintained in the background
access.endpointPending: An external address will appear after setup
access.copyManually: Select the address and copy it manually.
access.verified: Passed an external check. This reflects the most recent check.
access.notVerified: Public reachability has not been verified. Test this address using mobile data. An administrator can configure independent external checks.
access.savedDescription: PandaHome is maintaining the access route. Check the service card for results.
access.deleteDescription: Stop maintaining public access for “{name}” and clean up its access mapping. The local service will remain installed.
access.formDescription: Enter the service’s local network address. PandaHome will keep checking and restoring its access route.
access.name: Service name
access.localIpHelp: Use a local network IP for direct access. Only relay mode accepts 127.0.0.1. A fixed local IP is recommended.
access.publicPortHelp: Remote visitors use this port for both direct and relay access.
access.automaticHelp: Recommended: connect directly when possible; otherwise use the configured public relay.
access.relayRequired: The public relay is not ready yet. You can save now; access will retry after an administrator completes setup.
access.domainHelp: Optional. Keep an authorized Aliyun domain in sync automatically. Leave blank to use an IP or relay address. A domain does not remove the need for the external port.
access.rr: Host record (@ for the root domain)
access.leaseHelp: Defaults to 3600 seconds and renews automatically. Use 0 for a permanent lease, or 60–604800 seconds.
access.publishNotice: Saving opens an external route to this service. Protect the service with authentication first. HTTPS is not automatically added to your application.

networkHelp.direct: The router and observed public addresses match. Automatic port mapping can be attempted; carrier and firewall rules still determine reachability.
networkHelp.relay: An upstream network may block direct incoming access. A public relay lets your home host establish an outgoing connection.
networkHelp.unknown: The network could not be classified reliably. Retry when connectivity is available, or ask an administrator to check router and relay settings.

dns.error: Update failed; check Aliyun permissions and domain settings

validation.requiredName: Enter a name you can recognize.
validation.invalidIp: Enter a valid IPv4 address, such as 192.168.1.10.
validation.invalidPort: Service and external ports must be integers from 1 to 65535.
validation.invalidDomain: Enter a root domain such as example.com, without a protocol or port.
validation.invalidRr: Enter a valid host record, such as home, or @ for the root domain.
validation.invalidLease: Use 0 for a permanent lease, or an integer from 60 to 604800 seconds.
validation.loopbackRequiresRelay: Use a local network IP for direct or automatic mode. 127.0.0.1 is supported only with explicitly selected relay mode.

reasons.disabled: Automatic maintenance is paused. Edit this service to enable it again.
reasons.checking: Checking the service and access route. Please wait.
reasons.network_unknown: The network could not be classified. Run detection again or check the administrator settings.
reasons.direct_unavailable: Automatic direct access is unavailable. Check the router’s UPnP setting or configure a public relay.
reasons.relay_not_configured: An administrator must configure a public relay. PandaHome will retry afterward.
reasons.relay_binary_missing: The relay client is missing or cannot run. Ask an administrator to follow the setup guide.
reasons.relay_process_exited: The relay connection stopped. PandaHome will retry; check the relay server and client settings.
reasons.relay_unverified: The relay has started; an external check is still needed. Test the address using mobile data.
reasons.inbound_unverified: The route is configured; an external check is still needed. Test using mobile data, then check upstream routing, carrier rules and firewalls if access fails.
reasons.local_unreachable: The local service cannot be reached. Check its IP, port and local firewall.
reasons.mapping_conflict: The external port is already in use. Edit the service to choose another port.
reasons.mapping_failed: The router could not create the mapping. Check UPnP settings and network connectivity.
reasons.dns_failed: Domain synchronization failed. Check Aliyun permissions, domain and host record.
reasons.probe_failed: The external check failed. Check the service, router or relay. PandaHome will retry automatically.
reasons.relay_unregistered: The relay has not accepted this port. Check port conflicts, the access token and relay settings; maintenance will retry.
reasons.relay_ssh_binary_missing: The SSH client is unavailable. Check the installed tools in connection settings.
reasons.relay_ssh_start_failed: The SSH connection could not start. Check its credentials, trusted hosts and local port.
reasons.relay_ssh_process_exited: The SSH connection stopped. PandaHome will retry; check the connection settings.

setup.title: Public access settings
setup.description: Configure the connection to your public relay, then publish and manage LAN services from PandaHome.
setup.directBody: Run PandaHome on an always-on host in your home network, enable UPnP on the router and give the application host a fixed local IP. The public access page detects network conditions.
setup.directCheck: Matching public addresses and a successful mapping establish a possible route. Carrier restrictions, upstream routers and firewalls can still block access. Verify from outside your home network.
setup.relayServer: Prepare a publicly reachable frps server with authentication and the required public ports. This server is infrastructure you manage separately.
setup.relayClient: Install a compatible frpc client on the PandaHome device. PandaHome starts and maintains it; do not run another client for the same published port.
setup.relayConfigure: Save the relay address, public visitor address and credentials in the form above. If needed, enable SSH and configure certificate verification.
setup.relayRestart: Return to public access to enable your service. PandaHome maintains its own relay and SSH connections and restores saved services after restarting.
setup.verifyBody: After saving, turn off Wi-Fi on your phone and test the address on the service card using mobile data. Check that the application has authentication and HTTPS where required.
setup.probeBody: Access is marked externally verified only after a configured independent public probe succeeds. Otherwise it stays awaiting verification; test from outside the network. UDP needs an application-level check.
setup.reference: The public relay address belongs to the relay server, not necessarily to the network running PandaHome.

access.adminDescription: Only administrators can publish and manage public access. Sign in with an administrator account or contact the home server administrator.

relaySettings.title: Relay connection settings
relaySettings.description: Connect PandaHome to a public relay you already operate. PandaHome saves these settings and maintains the connection for your published services.
relaySettings.loadFailed: Relay settings could not be loaded.
relaySettings.adminOnly: Only an active administrator can change relay settings.
relaySettings.defaultSource: Using server defaults. Save here to manage the connection in PandaHome.
relaySettings.serverHelp: The address where the relay accepts PandaHome connections. Enter a host without a scheme or port.
relaySettings.serverSshHelp: The frps address as seen from the SSH server, often 127.0.0.1. This is separate from the public visitor address.
relaySettings.publicHostHelp: The public IP or hostname visitors use. Service ports are set separately. Enter no scheme, path or port.
relaySettings.tokenSaved: A token is already saved. Leave this field blank to keep it; enter a new token to replace it.
relaySettings.tokenHelp: Use the authentication token configured on your relay server. It will not be displayed after saving.
relaySettings.removeTokenWarning: Removing the token can disconnect enabled relay services.
relaySettings.tlsHelp: TLS protects the relay connection. For a private or self-signed certificate, supply its CA and expected server name.
relaySettings.caHelp: Path to the CA certificate on the device running PandaHome. The certificate must already be available there.
relaySettings.serverNameHelp: The name expected in the relay certificate; it may differ from the connection address.
relaySettings.sshHelp: Use SSH when the relay control port is reachable only from its own server. PandaHome maintains this connection automatically.
relaySettings.sshEnabled: Connect to the relay through SSH
relaySettings.sshIdentityHelp: Path to an existing private key on the PandaHome device. Private key contents are never displayed.
relaySettings.sshKnownHostsHelp: Path to the existing known_hosts file used to verify the SSH server identity.
relaySettings.sshLocalPortHelp: Use 0 to select an available loopback port automatically. A fixed port must not be used by another connection.
relaySettings.binaryHelp: Installed frp client name or absolute path on the PandaHome device.
relaySettings.applyNotice: Saving applies these settings to enabled relay services and may briefly interrupt them. The PandaHome device must stay online. A started connection still needs an external access check.
relaySettings.saved: Connection settings saved. PandaHome will apply them to enabled relay services; check the public access page for current status.
relaySettings.invalidRelay: Enter a relay control address, a port from 1 to 65535, and an installed frpc executable.
relaySettings.invalidSsh: Complete the public relay address and SSH connection details. SSH ports must be 1–65535; use 0–65535 for the local port.
